summary: Retest of the iteration_54 delivery v3 fixes. Backend: the new tests/test_delivery_v3_fixes.py passed 14/14 and the regression tests/test_delivery_v3_scheduling.py passed 11/11. Verified: with no settings doc, calculate-fee, quote and GET settings fall back to the default morning/evening slots. POST /orders rejects a scheduled order with no date, today's date, a date 10 days out, a bad slot or a missing slot (all 400). A full slot returns 409, and remaining is clamped to 0 when the slot is overbooked. A valid order returns 200 and saves date and slot. 8 concurrent tip requests give exactly one 200 (1 wallet debit, 1 transaction). A failed low-balance tip releases the lock. Shipping orders are never offered to drivers. queue/pickup skips orders assigned to another driver and pending/cancelled orders. A planned stop that is not yet en route gets no driver location or route from /live, while the en-route stop does. The WS sub initial location gating is correct by code review. UI (390x844): checkout scheduled flow worked end to end: day chips, slot modal, then place order returned 200 with the chosen date and slot saved. A full slot shows 'Full'/'ممتلئة' and is disabled. The ZENREX map label no longer overlaps the driver earnings chip. Fleet Scheduling plan-prev/plan-next change the date. Delivery-settings slot rows wrap. One fix is NOT complete: the delivery-settings tab pills are still 116px tall. No deprecated expo packages.

minor.issue: The capacity check is read-then-insert with no atomic reservation, so two concurrent orders can both take the last spot in a slot. Low risk.
find() then update_one() with no driver_id guard in the update filter. An express acceptance between the two calls could be overwritten. Add driver_id {$in:[None,'',uid]} to the update filter.
The initial driver_loc is hidden for every viewer of a planned, not-en-route order, including merchant/fleet. /live hides it only for the customer. This is inconsistent but harmless.

ui_bugs.issue: STILL BROKEN: the horizontal ScrollView tab pills stretch to about 116px tall (they should be about 40px), with a big empty purple or grey block under each label. Fix: style={{flexGrow:0}} on the ScrollView plus alignItems:'center' (or 'flex-start') in contentContainerStyle s.tabs. Ref: app/merchant/delivery-settings.tsx:131,297

After a successful order on web, Alert.alert does nothing, so the user stays on checkout with no feedback (the order is created and the cart cleared). Works on native. Consider a web fallback such as router.replace to track-order. Ref: app/checkout.tsx:151

issues: The slot button text uses the raw Arabic label in non-Arabic UI ('Period: الفترة الصباحية (14:00 - 09:00)'), and the mixed RTL reverses the time order. Wrap the label in tSync: tf(..., [tSync(scheduledSlot.label, lang), ...]). Ref: app/checkout.tsx:240
plan-prev/plan-next chips are 44x38 (below the 44 minimum height).
In LTR (English) the chevrons point the wrong way: prev on the left shows '>' and next on the right shows '<'. Choose the icon based on RTL. Ref: app/merchant/fleet.tsx:128-130
Slot rows now wrap, but the '-' separator is left at the end of the first line. The trash icon is an 18px touch target with no testID, and the '+ Period' button has no testID.

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed a test cleanup bug: test_delivery_v3_scheduling.py deleted loyalty_transactions by 'order_id', but the server stores 'ref_id'. Each run leaked about 11.5k loyalty points to the customer 0500000000. I removed 5 orphan earn transactions from 2026-10-30, which brings the customer's loyalty balance back to its previous value.
The tip lock and release pattern is correct (conditional $set on tip $exists:false, $unset when the wallet debit fails).
